questions.question: If Priya and Renu can do a job in 12 hours (working together at their respective constant speeds) and Priya can do the job alone in 18 hours, in how many hours can Renu do the job alone?
questions.questionHtml: If Priya and Renu can do a job in 12 hours (working together at their respective constant speeds) and Priya can do the job alone in 18 hours, in how many hours can Renu do the job alone?
questions.solution:
(P + R) ×  12 = 72 ⇒(P + R) = 6

Now it is given that Priya takes 18 hours to complete the work alone

⇒P × 18 = 72 ⇒P = 4 ,The efficiency of Priya is 4

⇒R = 6 - 4 = 2, The efficiency of Renu is 2,

⇒72 = Time × 2 ⇒ 72/2 = 36 = Time

questions.question: If 15 people take 5 days to complete a job, in how many days can 25 people finish that work?
questions.questionHtml: If 15 people take 5 days to complete a job, in how many days can 25 people finish that work?
questions.solution:
Total work = 15 × 5 = 75 units

Time taken by 25 people to complete the work = 75 ÷ 25 = 3 days

questions.question: A and B working together can finish a piece of work in 8 days while B alone can do it in 24 days. In how many days can A alone finish the work?
questions.questionHtml: A and B working together can finish a piece of work in 8 days while B alone can do it in 24 days. In how many days can A alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
Let the total work is the 24 units (LCM of 8 and 24)

The efficiency of A + B is 24 / 8 = 3 units

The efficiency of A is  24 / 24 = 1 unit

The efficiency of B is (3 - 1) = 2 units

The number of days B takes 24 / 2 = 12 days.

questions.question: If A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days, and A alone can do the same work in 30 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the same work?
questions.questionHtml: If A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days, and A alone can do the same work in 30 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days

Part of work A and B can do in 1 day = 1/20

A alone can do the work in 30 days

Part of work A can do in 1 day = 1/30 

Part of work B alone can do in a day = 1/20 - 1/30 = 1/60

questions.question: In a factory, a piece of work is completed by Raima in 15 days while Joe can finish it in 10 days. The factory manager has to complete the work as soon as possible and so he orders Joe and Raima to work together. How many days will they take to complete the work?
questions.questionHtml: In a factory, a piece of work is completed by Raima in 15 days while Joe can finish it in 10 days. The factory manager has to complete the work as soon as possible and so he orders Joe and Raima to work together. How many days will they take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
Combined Work efficiency = (1/15) + (1/10)  = 5/30 = 1/6  

Days to Complete the Work =1 / (1/6) = 6 days

questions.question: Ram and Shawan working together can complete a job in 5 hours, where as Ram alone can complete the same job in 6 hours. In how many hours can Shawan alone complete the job?
questions.questionHtml: Ram and Shawan working together can complete a job in 5 hours, where as Ram alone can complete the same job in 6 hours. In how many hours can Shawan alone complete the job?
questions.solution:
Time taken by Ram and Shawan together = 5 hours 

Efficiency of Ram and Shawan = 30/ 5 = 6 unit/hours

As, Ram alone takes 6 hrs.

Hence, Efficiency of Ram = 30/6 = 5 unit/hours

Now, Efficiency of Shawan = ( 6 -5) = 1 unit/h

No. of hours taken by Shawan = 30/1 = 30 hours.

questions.question: Arun alone can finish a work in 12 days and Shama alone can do it in 15 days. How much time will be taken to finish the work, if Arun and Shama work together?

questions.question: A can complete a task in 6 days, while B can complete the same task in 12 days. How many days will they take to complete the same task if they work together?
questions.questionHtml: A can complete a task in 6 days, while B can complete the same task in 12 days. How many days will they take to complete the same task if they work together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by A to complete the work =  6 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 12 days

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

LCM of 6 and 12 is 12

Efficiency of A = (12/6) = 2 units/days

Efficiency of B = (12/12) = 1 unit/day

Time taken by A and B both to complete the same task together = [12(2 + 1)] days

⇒ 12/3 days

⇒ 4 days

∴ The required time is 4 days

questions.question: Shyam can complete a task in 12 days by working 10 hours a day. How many hours a day should he work to complete the task in 8 days?
questions.questionHtml: Shyam can complete a task in 12 days by working 10 hours a day. How many hours a day should he work to complete the task in 8 days?

According to the formula

1 × 10 × 12 = 1 × T2 × 8

⇒ T2 = 120/8

∴ T2 = 15 hrs.

questions.question: If 18 men can cut a field in 35 days, then in how many days can 21 men cut the same field?
questions.questionHtml: If 18 men can cut a field in 35 days, then in how many days can 21 men cut the same field?

As we know,

questions.question: In a typing shop, Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days, while Amit can finish the same work in 8 days. How many days will they take together to complete the work?
questions.questionHtml: In a typing shop, Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days, while Amit can finish the same work in 8 days. How many days will they take together to complete the work?
questions.solution:
Given:

Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days

Amit can finish the same work in 8 days

Formula Used:

Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

Calculations:

⇒ Let the total work = x

Lalit can complete typing of a book in 9 days

⇒ Do work in one day(Efficiency)= \(\frac{x}{9}\)

Similarly,

Amit can finish the same work in 8 days

⇒ Do work in one day(Efficiency)= \(\frac{x}{8}\)

⇒ The efficiency of both Lalit and Amit= \(\frac{x}{9}+\frac{x}{8}=\frac{8x+9x}{72}=\frac{17x}{72}\)

According to the formula,

⇒ Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

⇒ Time taken= \(\frac{Total \space work}{Efficiency}=\frac{x}{\frac{17x}{72}}=\frac{72}{17}\)=4.23 days

Hence, The total time taken to typing the book is 4.23 days

questions.question: If A alone can complete a work in 20 days and B alone can complete the same work in 30 days, then which of the following statement(s) is/are correct? I. Ratio of efficiency of A and B is 3 ∶ 2. II. Working together A and B can complete the same work in 12 days.
questions.questionHtml:
If A alone can complete a work in 20 days and B alone can complete the same work in 30 days, then which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

I. Ratio of efficiency of A and B is 3 ∶ 2.

II. Working together A and B can complete the same work in 12 days.
questions.solution:
The work done by A in one day = 1/20, and the work done by B in one day = 1/30.

Their work done in one day working together = (1/20) + (1/30) = 1/12.

Therefore, A and B can complete the work together in 12 days. So, statement II is correct.

Hence, both statement I and statement II are correct.

questions.question: Supraja and Kausalya can complete a work in 30 days and 20 days, respectively. If Supraja starts the work and they work on alternate days, in how many days will 75% of the work be completed?
questions.questionHtml: Supraja and Kausalya can complete a work in 30 days and 20 days, respectively. If Supraja starts the work and they work on alternate days, in how many days will 75% of the work be completed?
questions.solution:
Let the total work is the 60 units (LCM of 30 and 20)

The efficiency of Supraja is 60 / 30 = 2 units

The efficiency of Kausalya is  60 / 20 = 3 units

In 2 days they do 3 + 2 = 5 units

75% of the total work is 60 × 3/4 = 45 units

So they will take (45 / 5) × 2 = 18 days.

questions.question: P and Q together can complete a work in 20 days. If Q alone can complete the work in 25 days, then in how many days P alone can complete the same work?
questions.questionHtml: P and Q together can complete a work in 20 days. If Q alone can complete the work in 25 days, then in how many days P alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of P be x units/day.

Therefore, the efficiency of Q will be (5-x) units/day.

Given that Q alone can complete the work in 25 days.

Hence, the efficiency of Q is (100/25) = 4 units/day.

Therefore, (5-x) = 4, x = 1

Hence, the efficiency of P is 1 unit/day.

Therefore, P alone can complete the work in 100/1 = 100 days.

questions.question: X and Y together can finish a piece of work in 15 days, while Y alone can finish it in 40 days. X alone can finish the work in:

Given :

X and Y together can finish a piece of work in 15 days, while Y alone can finish it in 40 days.

Concept used :

Number of working days = Total work/Work done per day 

Calculations :

Total work = LCM of 15 and 40 

⇒ 120 units 

Now,

X and Y per day work = 120/15 

⇒ 8 units 

Y's per day work = 120/40 

⇒ 3 units 

X's per day work = 8 - 3 

⇒ 5 units 

Total working days for X = 120/5 

⇒ 24 days 

∴ Total working days for X will be 24.

questions.question: Ram can complete a piece of work in 18 days, Reena can complete the same work in 12 days, and with the help of Shyam, they finish the same work in six days. In how many days can Shyam alone complete the same work?
questions.questionHtml: Ram can complete a piece of work in 18 days, Reena can complete the same work in 12 days, and with the help of Shyam, they finish the same work in six days. In how many days can Shyam alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by Ram  to complete a work = 18 days

Time taken by Reena to complete a work = 12 days

Time taken by Ram, Reena and Shyam together to complete a work = 6 days

Concept used:

Time taken to complete a work is inversely proportional to efficiency

Calculation:

Total work = 36 (LCM of 18, 12 and 6 = 36)

⇒ Efficiency of Ram = 36 / 18 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of Reena = 36 / 12 = 3

⇒ Efficiency of Ram, Reena and Shyam together = 36 / 6 = 6

⇒ Efficiency of Shyam (alone) = 6 - (2 + 3) = 1

⇒ Time taken by Shyam (alone) to complete a work = Total work / Efficiency of Shyam

⇒ Time taken by Shyam = 36 / 1 = 36 days

∴ The correct answer is 36 days.

questions.question: A can complete a task in 18 days while B can complete the same task in 12 days. If both work together for 6 days, and then A leaves. In how many days will B complete the remaining task?
questions.questionHtml: A can complete a task in 18 days while B can complete the same task in 12 days. If both work together for 6 days, and then A leaves. In how many days will B complete the remaining task?
questions.solution:
Given :

A can complete a task in 18 days while B can complete the same task in 12 days.

Both worked for 6 days, then A left. 

Concept used :

Total work = Work per day × Number of working days 

Calculations :

Total work = LCM of 12 and 18 = 36 units 

A's per day work = 36/18 = 2 units 

B's per day work = 36/12 = 3 units 

Their total work in 6 days = 6 × (2 + 3) 

⇒ 30 units 

Remaining work = 36 - 30 = 6 units 

Time taken by B to complete the remaining work = 6/3 

⇒ 2 days 

∴ Option 2 will be the right answer.

questions.questionHtml: A alone can complete a task in 3 days and B alone can complete the same task in 6 days. In how many days can A and B complete it together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by A to complete the work = 3 days 

Time taken by B to complete the work = 6 days 

Concept used:

Total work = LCM 

Efficiency = Total work/Total time 

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of 3 and 6 = 6

Efficiency of A = 6/3 = 2

Efficiency of B = 6/6 = 1

Efficiency of A + B = 2 + 1 = 3

Total days took if A and B works together = 6/3 = 2 days

∴ Total days took if A and B works together is 2 days

questions.question: A and B can do a certain work in 6 hours, and A, B and C together take 4 hours to do the same. How long will it take for C alone to accomplish the task?
questions.questionHtml: A and B can do a certain work in 6 hours, and A, B and C together take 4 hours to do the same. How long will it take for C alone to accomplish the task?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be [LCM of 4 and 6] 12 units, efficiency of A and B = 12/6 = 2 units/hour

The efficiency of A, B and C = 12/4 = 3 units/hour so, efficiency of C = 3 - 2 ⇒ 1 unit/hour

Time to complete the task by C = 12/1 ⇒ 12 hours

questions.question: P and Q together can complete a piece of work in 6 days. If P can alone complete the work in 18 days, then the number of days required for Q to finish the work is:
questions.questionHtml: P and Q together can complete a piece of work in 6 days. If P can alone complete the work in 18 days, then the number of days required for Q to finish the work is:
questions.solution:
P’s 1-day work = 1/18

(P + Q)’s 1-day work = 1/6

Q’s 1 day work = 1/6 – 1/18 = 1/9 ⇒ Q = 9 days

questions.question: A and B, working together, take 15 days to complete a piece of work. If A alone can do this work in 18 days, then how long would B take to complete the same work?
questions.questionHtml: A and B, working together, take 15 days to complete a piece of work. If A alone can do this work in 18 days, then how long would B take to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Work rate of A = 1/18 ⇒ The work rate of A and B together = 1/15

1/18 + 1/B = 1/15 ⇒ 1/B = 1/15 - 1/18 ⇒ 1/B = (18 - 15) / (15 × 18)

1/B = 3 / 270 ⇒ 1/B = 1 / 90 ⇒ B = 90

questions.question: Amit and Sunil together can complete a work in 9 days, Sunil and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 12 days, and Amit and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 18 days. In how many days will they complete the work if Amit, Sunil and Dinesh work together?
questions.questionHtml: Amit and Sunil together can complete a work in 9 days, Sunil and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 12 days, and Amit and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 18 days. In how many days will they complete the work if Amit, Sunil and Dinesh work together?
questions.solution:
A = Amit, S = Sunil and D = Dinesh

Total work = LCM of (9, 12 and 18) = 36

Hence, efficiency of A + S = 4

Efficiency of S + D = 3

Efficiency of A + D = 2

Now, Efficiency of A + S + D = (4 + 3 + 2)/2 = 9/2

∴ A, S and D together work in = 36/(9/2) = 4 × 2 = 8 days
